column1: # English, written for kaikki-to-yomitan's kty-en-en (revision 2025.04.08), whose
# first result is the lemma for these words. Regular forms such as "walked" or
# "children" have their own form-of entries there, which come first.
We borrowed my brother's car for the weekend.
Tomorrow I will paint the fence.
Please don't touch the wet paint.
She looked the word up in her dictionary.
He turned the radio off before bed.
Teacher's notes are on the desk.
We are going to paint the kitchen.
It is a five-minute walk to the station.
